origin.origins_backgrounds.acolyte.name: Acolyte
origin.origins_backgrounds.acolyte.descr: Iḥeckulen slemden-d sɣur imesbaṭliyen yerna sɛan taflest meqqren.
origin.origins_backgrounds.athlete.name: Anaddal
origin.origins_backgrounds.athlete.descr: Inaddalen sselmaden tfekka-nsen alamma d taggara.
origin.origins_backgrounds.farmhand.name: Afellaḥ
origin.origins_backgrounds.farmhand.desc: Sɛeddant lweqt deg ufellaḥ n wayeḍ.
origin.origins_backgrounds.fisher.name: Fisherfolk
origin.origins_backgrounds.guard.name: Aɛessas
origin.origins_backgrounds.guard.descrip: Ammesten n wiyaḍ d wayen yesɛan azal yesselmed-asen amek ara mmesten iman-nsen daɣen.
origin.origins_backgrounds.haunted.name: Haunted
origin.origins_backgrounds.haunted.descr: Mačči d ibeṛṛaniyen i tillas d tmucuha, Wid yettwaḥewwsen ttawint s tsusmi lmerta-nsent. S umata.
origin.origins_backgrounds.retainer.name: Aḥraz
origin.origins_backgrounds.retainer.desc: Yettkemmil ansay n twacult n uqeddac n yiwen n Rebbi neɣ n uṣebbaṛ.
origin.origins_backgrounds.novice_mage.d: Imaynuten bdan asluɣmu-nsen ddaw n uselḥar.
origin.origins_backgrounds.sailor.name: Sailor
origin.origins_backgrounds.sailor.descri: Aṭas n wakud i sɛeddayen yimellalen deg usfeḍ n tqacuct.
origin.origins_backgrounds.pirate.name: Amakar
origin.origins_backgrounds.pirate.descri: D lebḥer kan i ḥemmlen. D izemṛaden. Aṭas n izemṛaden.
origin.origins_backgrounds.cultist.name: Aḥeckil
origin.origins_backgrounds.cultist.descr: Wid yettɛeddin ɣer ddin, xeddmen i yilluten-nsen s yiberdan ur nettban.
origin.origins_backgrounds.scribe.name: Aru
origin.origins_backgrounds.scribe.descri: Ɣer taggara ad ffɣent tɛebbuḍin-nni n ufus.
origin.origins_backgrounds.soldier.name: Aserdas
origin.origins_backgrounds.fresh_face.de: Ur ɛad xedmen kra n tɣawsa.
origin.origins_backgrounds.coalminer.des: Yessefk ad d-yettwakkes akk uẓru n lqaɛa, mačči d lmerqa kan.
origin.origins_backgrounds.cryptkeeper.d: Aẓeṭṭa n yiẓekwan n wid yemmuten, d axeddim iweɛren ma ur qqimen ara deg umkan-nsen.
power.origins_backgrounds.improved_heali: Aseḥlu yesɛa 10% n usemres ugar fell-ak.
Ad tesɛuḍ ugar n tneččit mi ara teččeḍ iselman yemsewwaḍen. (Ur d-yettwaskan ara s AppleSkin)
power.origins_backgrounds.shield_prowess: Mi ara tesqedceḍ aḥuddu, ad d-trebḥeḍ Resistance I.
power.origins_backgrounds.trusty_hoe.des: Ɣur-k yiwet n tkerrist n wuzzal yettwaǧǧan seg tsuta ɣer tsuta.
power.origins_backgrounds.attack_in_ocea: Mi ara tiliḍ deg lebḥer, timenɣiwin-ik ttɣawalent s snat n tikkal.
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.name: Eyepatch
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.descr: Ma telsiḍ tačeqlalt deg yilel yeldin, ad teǧǧeḍ tamuɣli-k deg yiḍ.
power.origins_backgrounds.graves.name: Uɣal ɣer Crypts-ik
power.origins_backgrounds.graves.descrip: Tamussni-inek ɣef wid yemmuten ad k-teǧǧ ad ternuḍ 7.5% n wuguren i wid ur nemmut ara.
power.origins_backgrounds.legacy_sword.d: Tettawiḍ ajenwi n twacult-ik. D ayla n baba-k, n yemma-s d...
power.origins_backgrounds.paperbacks.des: Seld ad taruḍ aṭas n yidlisen, tlata n lkaɣeḍ kan i k-ilaqen akken ad teqqneḍ yiwen.
power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.name: Tiyuzaḍ n usfel
power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.desc: Asfel n yiyuzaḍ i bab-ik, ad ak-d-yefk snat n tikkal n termit.
Asluɣmu-inek s usekkin ad k-yeǧǧ ad txedmeḍ ugar n 5% n wuguren ticki tesseḥbibeḍ yiwen.
power.origins_backgrounds.potion_food.de: Teččaḍ aṭas n tiseṭṭa, tura d ayen yelhan yerna d ddwa.
